slow scan, one probe every ~9s (177 probes)
10 uploads of ~500 kB to a non-standard port

rules.name: Vertical port scan
rules.logic: ≥ 20 distinct ports on one host, failed handshakes, within 10 s

rules.name: Horizontal host sweep
rules.logic: ≥ 15 distinct hosts on one port (or ICMP echo), within 30 s

rules.name: SYN flood
rules.logic: ≥ 100 half-open connections to one service within 5 s

rules.name: Login brute force
rules.logic: ≥ 15 short sessions to a login port (21/22/23/3389/5900) within 60 s

rules.name: DNS tunneling
rules.logic: ≥ 10 queries with a label ≥ 30 chars or name ≥ 60 chars within 60 s

rules.name: Bulk upload to non-standard port
rules.logic: ≥ 1 MB sent to an external host on a non-standard port within 5 min

rules.name: Connection burst
rules.logic: ≥ 40 new connections from one source within 5 s
